about_the_game:
Nanomon are tiny, virtual pets who hang out in the corner of your screen! As you fed 'em, pet 'em and fight with 'em, you'll get to listen to some of the sweet, lo-fi sounds of Nanomon's nostalgic soundtrack. Just like when you stole your older brother's iPod and listened to everything he downloaded from Limewire, this is the kind of music to make whatever it is you're procrastinating on just fall into the background.

Nanomon's soundtrack was composed by Yoppi
